description: Property managed by GLAMAPARIS with a unique official from the Mairie de Paris. All bookings are covered by cancellation (Covid included) and liability insurance. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.Ideally located in the heart of Saint-Germain des Prés, near the magnificent Jardin du Luxembourg and the famous "Le Bon Marché" department store, this 3-bedroom apartment is on the 4th floor with elevator.The spaceIdeally located in the heart of Saint-Germain-des-Prés, close to the magnificent Jardin du Luxembourg, the Saint-Sulpice church, Montparnasse and the famous Le Bon Marché department store.Spacious and luxurious 4-room apartment (recently renovated by an architect) is located on the 4th floor with elevator of a 19th century Haussmannian building.Very comfortable, absolutely quiet (overlooking 2 interior courtyards) and with a surface area of ​​85 m², it consists of an entrance, a large, very bright living room furnished in a very contemporary way, a modern and fully equipped open kitchen, 3 double bedrooms, 2 double beds 160x200cm and 2 single beds 2x80x190cm which can be joined into a single bed, a bathroom with bathtub and toilet, and a shower room with shower and toilet.The apartment is very secure, thanks to the armoured door at the entrance and the digital code to access the building. It also has a safe.Ideal for exploring Paris and its many tourist sites as well as for shopping because it is located near many luxury shops and boutiques.The apartment is very well served by public transport and next to a bicycle station ("VELIB") and cars ("AUTOLIB") for rent.Nearest metro stations: Sèvres-Babylone (lines 10 and 12), Rennes (line 12), Saint-Sulpice (line 4).The apartment is non-smoking and pets are not allowed.Not suitable for people
